title: Reusable Building Pipeline
summary: A standard for building reusables, so that quality and speed stop competing. Quality means I can still understand a reusable a year later, and someone else can work out how to use it about 70% of the way on their own. Speed means the distance from "the note is written" to "the note is on the site…
